notes.title: Merch Drop!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770427/8f67b025fcb9abd7eff74840c1a3977160d0f2b1.png[/img]

Have you ever looked around your room and thought, man, I want a poster of a little green guy covering my walls? What about Irish lesbians embracing for the first time in eons? Perhaps an old promotional poster for a very niche game? Well, what if I told you that you can have it all if you visit: https://marcelinehileman.artstation.com/store/art_posters !!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770427/d2ee2179bae52dd24d14a3cebe549209f57b4c44.png[/img]

That's right! Our character artist has been hard work creating prints recently, and this includes prints of Erin and the Otherworld content! Be sure to go and check it out! There may even be more prints in the future...
